title: Slope 3D
description: High-octane neon runner rolling down a twisting 3D slope. Dodge obstacles, jump speed ramps, and survive at terminal velocity.
controls: A / D or Left / Right arrow keys to steer. Screen swipe on mobile.

title: Tetris Matrix
description: The definitive falling blocks puzzle. Clear lines, trigger matrix combos, use hold queue and ghost piece projection.
controls: Arrow keys / WASD to move & rotate. Space to Hard Drop. C to Hold piece.

title: 2048 Classic
description: Slide matching numbered tiles across the 4x4 grid. Merge numbers to build powers of two and reach the legendary 2048 tile.
controls: Arrow keys, WASD, or swipe on touchscreen to slide tiles in 4 directions.

title: Pac-Man Arcade
description: Munch all pac-dots in the classic maze while outsmarting Blinky, Pinky, Inky, and Clyde. Grab power pellets to turn the tables!
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to navigate maze corridors.

title: Neon Snake
description: Smooth retro cyber snake. Gobble glowing neon orbs and rare golden apples to extend your tail without crashing.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to change direction. Space to start/restart.

title: Flappy Bird
description: Precision tap-to-fly arcade game. Navigate through narrow pipe openings with delicate physics and timing.
controls: Spacebar, Up Arrow, or click/tap to flap wings and gain altitude.

title: Asteroids 1979
description: Authentic vector space shooter with inertia physics. Rotate, thrust across deep space, and blast asteroids to dust.
controls: Left / Right to rotate, Up / W to thrust rocket engines, Space to fire laser.

title: Breakout Matrix
description: Smash vibrant rows of brick clusters with bouncing balls. Collect paddle extenders, laser beams, and multi-ball splitters.
controls: Move mouse or Left / Right arrow keys to position paddle.

title: Neon Pong
description: The grandfather of video games revitalized with neon glow aesthetics, curve spin physics, and 1P or 2P competitive modes.
controls: Player 1: W / S or mouse. Player 2: Up / Down arrow keys.

title: T-Rex Dino Runner
description: The beloved offline chrome runner. Leap over desert cacti, duck underneath flying pterodactyls, and rack up high scores.
controls: Space / Up Arrow to jump. Down Arrow to duck.

title: Minesweeper Classic
description: Uncover numbers and logically deduce hidden mines. Flag danger squares and clear the minefield without detonation.
controls: Left click to reveal tile. Right click or long press to plant flag.

title: Connect 4
description: Classic vertical checker drop game. Strategically align 4 discs horizontally, vertically, or diagonally against smart AI or a friend.
controls: Click on any column to drop a checker disc.

title: Space Invaders
description: Descend into planetary defense. Blast relentless waves of marching alien armadas from behind protective disintegrating bunkers.
controls: Arrow keys or A / D to steer defense cannon. Spacebar to fire cannon.

title: Word Quest
description: 5-letter word deduction game. Six guesses to discover the mystery word using green, yellow, and gray letter feedback.
controls: Type on physical keyboard or click virtual keys. Press Enter to submit guess.
